findings.title: updateEvent calendar fallback can never resolve
findings.body: In updateEvent the code is `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When the fallback branch runs externalCalendarId is falsy, so the find compares against that same falsy value and always returns undefined. The previous code fell back to `event.destinationCalendar.externalId`. Now updates without an externalCalendarId call `calendar.events.update` with an undefined calendarId and fail.

findings.title: deleteEvent calendar fallback can never resolve
findings.body: In deleteEvent the code is `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When externalCalendarId is missing the find uses that same missing value and never matches, so calendarId is undefined and the delete falls back only to primary instead of the booking's destination calendar. The old code used `event.destinationCalendar.externalId` as fallback.

findings.title: Crash when destinationCalendar is empty
findings.body: EventManager.create does `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []; if (... && mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar")`. If destinationCalendar is null/undefined/empty the destructured value is undefined and accessing `.integration` throws TypeError, breaking booking creation for users without a destination calendar. It needs optional chaining.

findings.title: Collective second-host calendars dropped when organizer has none
findings.body: The new evt sets `destinationCalendar` to `null` when neither the event type nor the organizer has one, then does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. With null the optional chain no-ops, so collective hosts' destinationCalendars collected in teamDestinationCalendars are silently discarded and second hosts never get calendar events.

findings.title: Inverted IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED slug logic
findings.body: This PR flips organization creation from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && {slug})` / `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && {requestedSlug: slug})` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? {slug} : {})` / `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? {requestedSlug: slug} : {})`. That stores slug vs requestedSlug in the opposite billing mode from before, an unrelated breaking change to org provisioning that should not be in a destinationCalendar fix.

findings.title: updateEvent called with undefined credential
findings.body: In updateAllCalendarEvents when reference.credentialId is set but the credential is found neither in memory nor in the DB, `credential` remains undefined and the code still calls `updateEvent(credential, ...)`. getCalendar(undefined) throws, turning a missing-credential case for one host into a failure instead of being skipped or reported per-reference.
